eligibility: Small and marginal farmer families owning cultivable land
Land records must be in the applicant's name
Excludes institutional land holders and high-income tax-paying farmer families
benefits: Income support of Rs. 6,000 per year, paid in three equal installments of Rs. 2,000 directly to bank accounts.
application_process: Apply online at the PM-KISAN portal, or through the local Common Service Centre (CSC), or via the village revenue/agriculture officer.

eligibility: Economically Weaker Section (EWS), Low Income Group (LIG) or Middle Income Group (MIG) households
Applicant or family should not own a pucca house anywhere in India
Preference given to women as co-owners or owners
benefits: Interest subsidy on home loans and financial assistance for construction/purchase of a house, up to Rs. 2.67 lakh depending on income category.
application_process: Apply online through the PMAY-U portal or at a Common Service Centre with required documents.

name_en: National Scholarship Portal - Post Matric Scholarship
name_te: నేషనల్ స్కాలర్‌షిప్ పోర్టల్ - పోస్ట్ మెట్రిక్ స్కాలర్‌షిప్
eligibility: Students belonging to SC/ST/OBC/Minority/EWS categories studying post-matriculation courses
Family income below the prescribed threshold (varies by category)
Regular student in a recognized institution
benefits: Tuition fee reimbursement, maintenance allowance, and other course-related financial assistance.
application_process: Register and apply on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) within the notified window each academic year.

eligibility: Farmer families (including tenant farmers and land-less agricultural laborers) in Andhra Pradesh
Land record or tenancy documentation as per scheme guidelines
benefits: Annual financial assistance of Rs. 13,500 per farmer family, combining state and central (PM-KISAN) contributions.
documents_required: Land records or tenant farmer certificate
application_process: Apply through the village/ward secretariat or the official AP agriculture department portal.

eligibility: Senior citizens aged 60 years and above
Persons with disabilities (40% or more), single women, weavers, fishermen, transgender persons, and other specified categories
Below poverty line / eligible ration card household in Andhra Pradesh
benefits: Monthly pension ranging from approximately Rs. 3,000 to Rs. 10,000 depending on category, credited directly to the beneficiary.
application_process: Apply at the local village/ward secretariat with required documents; verification is done by the welfare assistant.

eligibility: Non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises
Indian citizen with a viable business plan
Loan requirement up to Rs. 10 lakh
benefits: Collateral-free loans under three categories: Shishu (up to Rs. 50,000), Kishor (up to Rs. 5 lakh), and Tarun (up to Rs. 10 lakh).
application_process: Apply at any participating bank, NBFC, or Micro Finance Institution, or online via the MUDRA/Udyamimitra portal.

eligibility: Pregnant women and lactating mothers for their first live birth
Applicant must not be a central/state government employee (with certain exceptions)
benefits: Cash incentive of Rs. 5,000 in installments for the first child, subject to conditions like health check-ups and registration.
application_process: Apply through the local Anganwadi Centre or approved health facility, or via the PMMVY web portal/app.

eligibility: Auto-rickshaw, taxi, and maxi-cab drivers who own their vehicle in Andhra Pradesh
Vehicle should be registered and used for commercial purposes
benefits: Annual financial assistance of Rs. 10,000 to support vehicle maintenance and insurance costs.
application_process: Apply through the village/ward secretariat with vehicle and identity documents.

name_en: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
name_te: ఆయుష్మాన్ భారత్ - ప్రధాన మంత్రి జన ఆరోగ్య యోజన
target_group: families seeking welfare or housing support
eligibility: Families identified as deprived/occupational category as per SECC database
No existing cap on family size, age, or gender
benefits: Health cover of up to Rs. 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
application_process: Check eligibility on the PM-JAY website or at a nearby Ayushman Bharat empanelled hospital / Common Service Centre.

eligibility: Students from economically weaker families studying in colleges/professional courses in Andhra Pradesh
Family annual income within prescribed limit
benefits: Full reimbursement of tuition fees directly to the mother's/guardian's bank account.
application_process: Apply through the Jagananna Vidya Deevena portal or the respective educational institution.

eligibility: Individuals above 18 years of age
At least VIII standard pass for projects above a specified cost
New micro-enterprise, not an expansion of an existing unit
benefits: Margin money subsidy of 15%-35% of project cost (varies by category and area) for setting up new micro-enterprises.
application_process: Apply online through the PMEGP e-portal (KVIC); interviews are conducted by the district task force committee.

name_en: YSR Aasara for Persons with Disabilities Pension
eligibility: Person with 40% or more disability as certified by a medical board
Resident of Andhra Pradesh with eligible household income
benefits: Monthly pension assistance (amount varies by disability category, higher for 80%+ disability).
application_process: Apply at the village/ward secretariat with medical board disability certificate.

eligibility: Girl child below 10 years of age
Account opened by parent or legal guardian
benefits: High-interest small savings scheme to fund a girl child's education and marriage expenses, with tax benefits.
application_process: Open an account at any post office or authorized bank branch with the required documents.

eligibility: Women aged 45 to 60 years from SC, ST, BC, and minority communities in Andhra Pradesh
Not already covered under other major state pension schemes
benefits: Financial assistance of Rs. 18,750 per year for four years to support small business/self-employment activities.
application_process: Apply through the village/ward secretariat; beneficiaries are identified via household surveys.

eligibility: Unorganized sector workers aged 18-40 years
Monthly income up to Rs. 15,000
Not covered under EPFO/ESIC/NPS (government-funded)
benefits: Minimum assured monthly pension of Rs. 3,000 after the age of 60, with matching government contribution.
application_process: Enroll at the nearest Common Service Centre with Aadhaar and bank account details.
